scene spacing ambulance3.#comment: Watchdog, not the parking rule: ambulance3 yields to firetruck1, firetruck2, ambulance1 (priority fire, ambulance 1, ambulance 2, police). When a stopped higher priority vehicle is inside the lateral and frontal limits of scene spacing pair, ambulance3 reverses along its own heading (2 s per step, at most 15 steps) until it is clear. A move that would drive through the other vehicle is not made (spacing blocked).
